title: Homogeneity of the discrete derivative
statement:
Fix an arity $n$ and a coordinate direction $i \in \{1,\dots,n\}$. For every scalar $c \in \bbr$ and every Boolean function $f : \{0,1\}^n \to \bbr$, the discrete derivative in direction $i$ commutes with scalar multiplication:
\[
  D_i(c \cdot f) = c \cdot D_i f,
\]
that is, scaling $f$ by $c$ scales its discrete derivative by the same factor.
hypotheses_covered: arity n and direction i ∈ Fin n
replaced:
The discrete derivative commutes with scalar multiplication:
$D_i(c\cdot f) = c\cdot D_i f$ for $c\in\bbr$.
